**Daily Devotional**

**July 3**

*30 Even the youths shall faint and be weary, and the young men shall utterly fall: 31 But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint. (Isaiah 40:30-31 KJV)*

Even at the time that the youths shall fall, those that wait (serve) upon the Lord will have their strength renewed by the Lord, and shall be able to keep on running and not become weary. What a wonderful promise that the Lord will give us the strength necessary to do His will for our lives. The Lord is promising to give us the strength to overcome the devil and all the difficulties that come at us while serving Him (James 4:7).

The Hebrew word “QAVAH” that was translated “wait” is not talking about sitting and doing nothing, but is what a waiter does in waiting on customers. So this is telling us that those who are serving the Lord and doing His will, shall have their strength come from the Lord, and not have to just rely upon our own human strength (Matthew 11:29). This is why the Lord’s servants can count on the strength to be able to accomplish whatever the Lord leads us to do, as He will give us the power to do it. Praise God for giving us so many blessings (Ephesians 1:3) to enjoy in this life, as well as in eternity. Thank you Lord!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
